_setCompletionOn.title: Set completion on
_setCompletionOn.description: Set completion based on either having scrolled into view or from the embedded content sending a message via the window.postMessage API

_src.title: URL
_src.description: Path to the page you want to display in the iframe

_initialWidth.title: Initial width
_initialWidth.description: The native width of the iframe contents. Used with the initial height to keep the iframe's aspect ratio as it resizes. If either is left empty, a ratio of 0.56 (16:9) is used

_initialHeight.title: Initial height
_initialHeight.description: The native height of the iframe contents. Used with the initial width to keep the iframe's aspect ratio as it resizes. If either is left empty, a ratio of 0.56 (16:9) is used

_dimensionDelegateSelector.title: Dimension delegate selector
_dimensionDelegateSelector.description: If the dimensions of the iframe should be delegated to a child element of the iframe, use this attribute to select which child element this is. Its size then replaces the initial width and height
